paper_metadata.title: Microstructure and properties of Nb-bearing high-strength low-alloy surfacing layers

evidence.quote: high-strength low-alloy surfacing layers with Nb content ranging from 0.0041 to 0.26 wt-% were prepared by adding Nb element into electrode coating and manual electric arc welding
The base material in this study is Q345 low-alloy steel with the dimension of 280 mm × 160 mm × 18 mm, its chemical composition is shown in Table 1

surfacing test specimens of multi-layer multi pass welding with the size of 200 mm × 25 mm × 20 mm were prepared by manual electric arc welding on Q345 steel. Besides, all the processes of welding are carried out by the same person using DC reverse with the current of 170 A and the welding speed of 18–22 cm min−1, the heat input is about 12.74 –14.17 kJ cm−1.
the QPF as reticulate with uneven distribution is less, and it can be obviously observed in the prior austenite grain boundaries, moreover , the size of QPF is varying

attributes.morphology: regular parallel strips, large aspect ratio, arranged in bundles

evidence.quote: when the Nb content is 0.0041%, the LB in surfacing layer is the width of about 100 – 200 nm, the regular parallel strips have large aspect ratio and are arranged in bundles according to definite orientation, moreover , the boundaries of strips are clear and straight.

attributes.size: about 100–200 nm at grain boundaries; about 600 nm in grains
attributes.location: grain boundaries and internal of grains

evidence.quote: the size of M/A constituents at the grain boundaries is about 100 – 200 nm, whereas it is about 600 nm in the grains
